name: «K-12»
source:
Welcome to the 'Stardust' Academy! Are you ready to fly to the moon?

The stars say no, but prove them otherwise!

Spend the short life of a boy named Kiyu and help him find his destiny!

[From [url=https://hummin-foxxx.itch.io/k-12]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到“星尘”学院！你准备好飞向月球了吗？

明星们说不，但要证明事实并非如此！

度过一个名叫Kiyu的男孩短暂的一生，帮助他找到自己的命运！

[来自[url=https://hummin-foxxx.itch.io/k-12]itch.io[/url]]
